content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

Selling music online today requires more than just a platform; it demands an infrastructure that guarantees ownership and control over your products. With increasing restrictions on payment options, many creators are turning to crypto payments as a solution. By utilizing NOWPayments for transactions, creators can significantly reduce their fees and retain greater profits. This approach not only empowers creators by providing them with full ownership of their digital assets but also ensures that they are not reliant on third-party platforms that can impose high fees and restrictions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure for selling music and accepting Bitcoin involves several key components that work together seamlessly. By deploying a solution using tools like Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for payment processing, creators can build a robust digital storefront. These tools are free to use and provide the necessary functions for automated delivery and payment verification. The architecture allows for immediate transaction confirmations and product delivery, ensuring a smooth purchasing experience for customers.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where access to payment processors is limited or non-existent. It caters to musicians, artists, and content creators who wish to sell digital products like music tracks, templates, and courses without incurring exorbitant fees. By leveraging this infrastructure, creators can reach a global audience while maintaining control over their sales, which is vital in today's digital economy. It empowers individuals to reclaim their financial sovereignty and operate independently.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, compared to Gumroad's 10%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The complete digital commerce stack consists of several essential components: hosting through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic via Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, data storage with Supabase or Google Sheets, and automatic payment processing through NOWPayments. Each of these tools plays a crucial role in the overall functionality of the store, ensuring that all processes from product listing to payment confirmation and delivery are automated and efficient. This cohesive architecture eliminates the need for traditional platforms while lowering costs and increasing efficiency.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling music online and accepting Bitcoin, first, choose a hosting service like Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Google Apps Script to handle orders and confirmations. After that, integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions, allowing customers to pay in various cryptocurrencies. Finally, upload your music products and configure automated delivery. This streamlined approach not only enhances your operational efficiency but also provides you with a sustainable and profitable way to sell digital music.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing a decentralized payment processor like NOWPayments. This option allows you to accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies directly, minimizing fees and maximizing your profits. By implementing a comprehensive digital infrastructure, you can create a fully functional online store that operates independently of traditional payment platforms.
Complete ownership of your digital products means no platform dependencies.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to dive deeper into building your own digital store, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit includes all six blueprints and seven templates necessary to deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack. You can explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook without PayPal or Stripe, utilize NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency payments. This method allows you to bypass traditional payment processors while retaining full control over your sales, ensuring a smooth and profitable transaction process.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way is to use a combination of free hosting platforms and a crypto payment processor like NOWPayments. This setup eliminates hefty platform fees and allows you to keep more of your profits from each sale.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by creating your own website using tools like Cloudflare Pages. Pair this with NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions, ensuring a fee-efficient way to sell your digital products directly.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% on each transaction, significantly less than platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. This fee structure enables you to retain more of your earnings from each sale.
Is it difficult to set up a digital store using this infrastructure?

Setting up a digital store using this infrastructure is straightforward. With free tools available and clear deployment steps, you can have your store operational quickly, allowing you to focus on creating and selling your products.
Automated delivery ensures customers receive their purchases instantly.
